description: WHEN TO USE: To see competitor mention trends over time — which competitors were mentioned by LLMs across multiple scans and how their visibility changed. Use for competitive trend analysis and reporting. REQUIRES: project_id from lbm_list_projects. RETURNS: Historical competitor mention statistics per date, with per-model breakdowns. NOTE: Response structure may differ between time_range and start_date/end_date params.

time_range.description: Time range shortcut (default: 30d). Overridden by start_date/end_date.

name: lbm_get_history
